events_seen: WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Fronge added Laquon Treadwell (WR, IND) (dropped Elijah Mitchell (RB, PHI)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Fronge added Austin Ekeler (RB, WAS) for $5 FAAB.
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Drew added Ashton Dulin (WR, IND) (dropped Brandin Cooks (WR, SF)).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Charles added Kyle McCord (QB, MIA) for $101 FAAB.
CUT (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Wingard released Case Keenum (QB, CHI).
TRADE (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Charles receives future considerations. Wingard receives Jarrett Stidham (QB, DEN).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Shaq added Tutu Atwell (WR, LAR).
WAIVER CLAIM (Nov 11 (yesterday)): Adam added DJ Uiagalelei (QB, LAC) (dropped Gregory Desrosiers (RB, NYG)).

WEEK 9 RESULTS: Ryan def. Corbishley, 115.7-90.9; Wingard def. Adam, 108.5-72.8; Kevin def. Drew, 104.2-47.4 (BLOWOUT); Fronge def. Charles, 137.6-133.7 (NAIL-BITER); Brent def. Jake, 165.5-113.3 (BLOWOUT); Mitchum def. Shaq, 153.9-138.5

tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: Fronge dropped $5 FAAB on Austin Ekeler AND claimed Treadwell off waivers yesterday, all while sitting at 9-9 and hosting Adam this week. Havana's regulatory flexibility apparently extends to the waiver wire.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Charles spent $101 on a quarterback, dealt Stidham to Wingard for future considerations, and is still somehow the most composed desk in the league. Crownline at $158.59 and the gap between first and second place is not a gap, it is a canyon.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Terrence E. Odom is 5-7 on the season and I need someone to explain to me why he is still allowed to submit locks. Five and seven. I want a formal review. I want it on the air. I want it this week.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: The 5-7 record is a product of variance in a small sample against an unusually unpredictable slate. The underlying model is sound. I will not be taking further questions from Bo Ruckman, who has somehow made pick-em into a personality.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, Terrence just said "underlying model" about a pick-em sheet. He is 5-7. There is no model. There is a coin and it is bent.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: The question I keep getting about this week's rankings is why Brent is sixth when he just posted 165.46, the highest single-game score in Week 9. The answer is in the third sentence of the write-up. He is 10-8. His running backs grade eleventh. Points scored do not change positional architecture.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Fronge over Charles last week before anyone on this network was willing to say it, and 137.6-133.7 is what happened. Crownline's one-loss in the last six weeks and it came from a team that relocated to Cuba and runs zero pick liquidity. That result deserves more than a footnote.

tweets.name: Chad Bellwether
tweets.text: Kevin vs Ryan this week is the matchup nobody is talking about and everyone should be. Kevin is the most fragile 13-5 in the league — Matteo's words, not mine — and Ryan just beat Corbishley by 25. RDC at $92.21 is already down ten percent. Another loss and that number moves again.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: DREW IS PLAYING MITCHUM THIS WEEK. DEEPWATER IS UP 3.5% AND POSTING 153.9 POINTS. ATLAS IS 0-18 AND LISTED AT $28.15. I REFUSE TO PREVIEW THIS MATCHUP WITH A STRAIGHT FACE.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: The Weekly Ledger is tracking something interesting heading into Week 10: Wingard just received a quarterback from Charles and cut Case Keenum on the same day, SDR is up 11.4% to $59.14, and the pick-em board has Bo and Jay tied at 8-4 with six weeks of games left to separate them. Worth watching all three threads.
